I'm sorry to hear your order arrived damaged. Here's what you should do:
Document the Damage:
Take photos of the damaged packaging itself, especially if it might indicate product damage
Take clear photos of the entire product and close-ups of the affected areas (like punctures or indentations)
Include a common object near the affected area to show scale
If there's a law tag with a barcode, photograph both the front and back
Note the date you unboxed the item
Contact Our Support Team:
Once you've documented everything, email the photos and a description of the damage to our support team along with your order details, email, and current shipping address. The team will review your documentation and guide you through the next steps.
Processing time for replacement requests may take up to 7 business days, not including any production time needed to make the replacement item. You can continue using the product while waiting for a resolution, and if a replacement is approved, removal of the damaged item will be included with the replacement delivery.

Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Yes, damaged items are handled differently from normal returns:
Damaged Items (Manufacturing Defects):
When an issue is caused by Avocado manufacturing or logistics, you can qualify for a replacement instead of needing to process a return or refund
Returns due to verified manufacturing defects are eligible for a full refund or replacement, including shipping fees, under our warranty
For furniture that arrives damaged, you must contact us within 3 days of delivery to arrange a repair, replacement, or return
The team will review your documentation and determine the next steps — all replacement requests need specialist review
Normal Returns (Change of Mind):
Subject to sleep trial periods and adjustment periods
May include restocking fees (like the 20% fee for furniture)
Shipping fees are typically non-refundable
Must meet specific eligibility requirements
The key difference is that damage caused by manufacturing or delivery issues can lead to a replacement at no cost to you, while normal returns follow the standard return policy with associated fees. However, the support team needs to review your documentation to confirm whether the damage qualifies for replacement coverage.
